scope: Precision/source amendment to the original first-eight rounded historical replay. Diagnostic native-input sensitivity, not lossless recovery, likelihood marginalization, population bias or paired timing intervention. No new outcomes read for this design.

source_time_amendment.previous_design: The original timing-pilot protocol used decimal half-unit .0005day and an offsetREAL4 qualifier. It remains unchanged as a historical artifact.
source_time_amendment.verified_chain: Native R8 epoch -> R4EP_ALL/FIT MJD−MJDOFF -> REAL8 VMJD with MJDOFF added -> %.3f. Compiled MJDOFF exactly0: full MJD was rounded to float32.
source_time_amendment.inverse_rule: Enumerate every float32 value whose libc printf matches the archived token, then take union of its inverse float32 midpoint cells for original native R8 time. Open endpoints by nextafter. No independent extra .0005 term is added to an already inverted print interval.
source_time_amendment.result: All32tokens identify onefloat32 state each; width .00390625day. The original header peak is itself float32 and has one compatible state, so no nonzero native peak-rounding perturbation exists.

inverse_flux_and_header_rule: For quoted flux/error and native zHEL,zCMB,MWEBV, enumerate compatible float32 states and take min/max states. Do not add a pre-float32 subcell: native likelihood sees that sameR4 state. Positiveerrors mandatory. Preserve formatting/unit tests against libc snprintf.
candidate_SIMLIB_time: All32same-band sourceSIMLIB times are unique in cells. A separate all-epoch source-time input branch is allowed after gates, labelled source-compatible candidate timestamps, not proven originalHEAD/PHOT/time/flags recovery. No flux replacement.
fixed_inputs: Same first8, NML3iterations, nativeMW94,B18, shape1/AV0/headerpeakfixed,RV1.518; original acceptance rules and omittedtruthheaders remain asbaseline. No new epoch/PHOTFLAG/truth creation.
stage_order: First exact instrumented absent/zero equivalence and ±.2 actual-start/fullstate gates must pass.
Freeze executor/input manifest before any precision fits and obtain exclusive root release.
8CID-renamed zero perturbation controls plus240coordinate endpointfits (120activeinputcoordinates) with deterministic reversible ID ledger; exactcontrolclosure exceptCID required.

32 deterministic corners: for each original object, maximize/minimize linearized native D and dataQ gradients computed from paired low/high endpoint responses. Choose high for zero slope. No score-based domain orcohort changes.

estimands.endpoint: D and dataQ shifts from matching roundedbaseline; fullstates,masks,nativecovariance andallfailures retained.
estimands.linear_envelope: For derivativeg from(low,high), sum coordinate extremal g*(endpoint−baseline) contributions includingasymmetricintervals. This is a first-order response envelope, not a rigorous global nonlinear bound.
estimands.corners: Report measurednonlinear remainder against that prediction and allcaps. No samples dropped or precisionchosen by outcome.
estimands.source_times: Describe candidate-time branch independently of endpoint/corner screen; passing doesnotrepairfluxrounding or selectioninformation.

numerical_gates.clone_control: exactnonCIDscienceFITRESfields; acceptedrow/data/error and fullnative states identical
numerical_gates.accepted_masks: sameband/sourceepochmultiplicity, allowing only declaredtime perturbations; anymaskchange failsengineering gate
numerical_gates.dataQ_change_cap: max(.01,.001*archived2021dataQ) for each object; originalengineeringcap unchanged. Apply to endpoints,corners,candidatetimes separately.
numerical_gates.noautomatic_repair: If any gatefails, preserveallrows andstop beforepaired timing. Noiteration/domain/toleranceexpansion.

resources.accounting: Carry allpriornativefit walltimes including originalfailedreplays,baseline2021,instrumentation state jobs. Checkremainingcap immediatelybeforeeachprocess. Buildtime separatelybounded180.
resources.execution: No nativejobs authorized by thisdesign. Requires frozenexecutor/inputmanifest and rootrelease.
